# BCDock

> Managed Business Central sandbox platform. Two equally first-class entry points: a portal for consultants, trainers, and sales engineers, and a `bcdock` CLI for developers, CI pipelines, and AI agents. Spin up a BC environment in minutes, hibernate to drop to a flat stored rate, resume on demand. Sandbox use only - not for production data.

**One API for everyone.** The portal, the `bcdock` CLI, CI pipelines and AI agents all call the same public Platform API. What that means for you:
- **Anything the portal can do, the CLI and your agents can do.** No capability is locked inside a UI, so everything you do by hand you can automate.
- **Our own staff tooling uses the same API, not a separate private route**, so the same authentication and request logging apply to it as to you.
- **Stable for automation:** CLI commands are stable, exit codes are documented, and every verb supports `--output json`.

## Canonical pages

- [What is BCDock?](https://docs.bcdock.io/) - orientation + onboarding paths
- [CLI quickstart](https://docs.bcdock.io/quickstart/cli/) - five commands to a running BC environment
- [CLI install](https://docs.bcdock.io/cli/install/) - install paths for macOS, Linux, Windows
- [CLI authentication](https://docs.bcdock.io/cli/auth/) - API key vs JWT, scopes, the three credential paths
- [CLI concepts](https://docs.bcdock.io/cli/concepts/) - pool vs environment, hibernation, billing model
- [CLI exit codes](https://docs.bcdock.io/cli/exit-codes/) - what each code means, what an agent should do
- [CLI command reference](https://docs.bcdock.io/cli/reference/bcdock/) - auto-generated from the binary; one page per verb
